modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On July 4, 1837: The Grand Junction Railway, the world's first long-distance railway with steam traction, opened between Birmingham and Newton Junction.
On July 4, 2004: Greece beats Portugal in the UEFA Euro 2004 Final and becomes European Champion for first time in its history.
On July 4, 1886: The Canadian Pacific Railway's first scheduled train from Montreal arrives in Port Moody on the Pacific coast, after six days of travel.
July 4 is observed as The first evening of Dree Festival, celebrated until July 7 (Apatani people, Arunachal Pradesh, India).
On July 4, 1943: World War II: The Battle of Kursk, the largest full-scale battle in history and the world's largest tank battle, begins in the village of Prokhorovka.
